title: Java Fullstack Developer
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
   

  

 Your Role
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise\-grade web applications.
* Build scalable backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
* Develop responsive and user\-friendly UI components using Angular or ReactJS.
* Design and consume RESTful APIs and Microservices.
* Collaborate with product owners, architects, and development teams.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment, and support activities.
* Ensure application performance, security, and scalability.


 Your Profile
   

  

* 5 to 15 years of relevant experience in Java Full Stack Development.
* Hands\-on experience in Angular or ReactJS.
* Design and develop scalable web applications using Java Full Stack technologies.
* Build and consume RESTful APIs and microservices.
* Strong communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Immediate joiners preferred.
* Candidates with less than 5 years of experience are not eligible for this role.


**What You Will Love About Working Here**
* You can shape your career with us. We offer a range of career paths and internal opportunities within Capgemini group. You will also get personalized career guidance from our leaders.
* You will get comprehensive wellness benefits including health checks, telemedicine, insurance with top\-ups, elder care, partner coverage or new parent support via flexible work.
* You will have the opportunity to learn on one of the industry's largest digital learning platforms, with access to 250,000\+ courses and numerous certifications.


 Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22\.1 billion.

title: SAP LeanIX
description:

Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Configure and customize SAP LeanIX Fact Sheets, fields, and Meta Models.
* Design and develop GraphQL and REST API integrations with enterprise systems.
* Implement data governance, validation, and data quality processes within LeanIX.
* Build and maintain dashboards, surveys, and reports for Enterprise Architecture insights.
* Automate data workflows, bulk operations, and integration processes to improve efficiency.


**Your Profile**
* 3\+ years of development experience, including 2\+ years of hands\-on SAP LeanIX experience.
* Strong knowledge of LeanIX Fact Sheets, Meta Models, custom fields, GraphQL APIs, surveys, and reporting.
* Hands\-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, OAuth2/Azure AD, JSON, and data modeling.
* Good understanding of Enterprise Architecture, IT landscape modeling, and LeanIX governance practices.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills, with a focus on data quality and automatiom.
